subsumed.unit: tests/actions-cache-proxy.test.mjs::restores: a service that keeps refusing the first read as busy ends as a failed restore, never a partial body

subsumed.unit: tests/anthropic-federation.test.mjs::a token Anthropic gives with less than two minutes left is used once and never cached

subsumed.unit: tests/api.test.mjs::development auth refuses production origin
subsumed.evidence: api.test.mjs:62-67 rejects DEV_AUTH with a production APP_ORIGIN and no separate console origin. console-host.test.mjs:362-369 instead keeps APP_ORIGIN local and supplies a production CONSOLE_ORIGIN. subsumed.unit: tests/api.test.mjs::every query parameter declares a type queryValues can produce from a string
subsumed.evidence: api.test.mjs:254-270 walks ROUTES and GLOBAL_ROUTES and rejects query schemas that cannot be produced from string coercion. subsumed.evidence: api.test.mjs:99-103 creates a project.read bearer token and uses it against another tenant's projects URL. subsumed.unit: tests/automerge.test.mjs::a request-changes from a review with incomplete coverage still blocks: withholding never needs full coverage
subsumed.evidence: automerge.test.mjs:396-407 explicitly marks an agent request-changes review coverageIncomplete=true and still requires REVIEW_REJECTED. subsumed.unit: tests/browser-switch.test.mjs::an ordinary build job is not affected by the browser switch
subsumed.evidence: browser-switch.test.mjs:78-84 turns browserTesting off and verifies an ordinary build still claims capacity. arm-builds.test.mjs:152-160 enables armBuilds for a multi-architecture job. The former guards isolation of the browser gate from ordinary builds, not ARM admission.

subsumed.evidence: capacity-reattempt.test.mjs:75-86 first consumes retries with CONTAINER_CAPACITY and then observes CONTAINER_NOT_READY at the ordinary platform bound. This specific mixed-failure transition protects the capacity exception from raising other failures' limit.

subsumed.unit: tests/check-packs.test.mjs::vendored and build directories never contribute a stack
subsumed.evidence: check-packs.test.mjs:77-80 supplies valid-looking manifests under node_modules, vendor and target/debug and expects no stacks. The subsumer at 68-76 supplies malformed or unread root manifests. Directory exclusion can fail independently of parse-error handling.

subsumed.unit: tests/configuration.test.mjs::every Worker variable, secret and binding read in src/ is registered
subsumed.evidence: configuration.test.mjs:20-23 checks unregisteredReads(CONFIGURATION_NAMES), covering every Worker environment read. feature-gates.test.mjs:74-78 checks that registered non-placeholder feature keys have gate sites. subsumed.unit: tests/credential-leak.test.mjs::recovery still accepts the target's configured secret
subsumed.evidence: credential-leak.test.mjs:249-253 recovers a failed, reconciliation-required release using its target's configured deployment secret and a different operator. quality.test.mjs:273-301 already sets up the same failure/checkpoint, uses the target's configured f.secret.id and an independent ops human, and asserts rolling_back plus generation and retained lock. subsumed.unit: tests/edge-auth.test.mjs::a real token is refused when replayed under another tenant or token identity
subsumed.evidence: edge-auth.test.mjs:115-121 tampers separately with a real token's tenant, token ID and secret, requiring 401 before any tenant call. subsumed.unit: tests/feature-gates.test.mjs::every non-placeholder switch in the registry has at least one gate call site
subsumed.evidence: feature-gates.test.mjs:74-78 requires each non-placeholder FEATURE_KEY to occur at a gate call site. configuration.test.mjs:20-23 only detects environment reads absent from the configuration registry. A registered but unenforced feature passes the latter and fails the former.

subsumed.unit: tests/native-job-secrets.test.mjs::a same-repository pull request run receives the mapped secrets

subsumed.unit: tests/native-job-secrets.test.mjs::negative: a secret whose project scope no longer includes the project fails the attempt

subsumed.unit: tests/native-job-secrets.test.mjs::negative: malformed capability entries count as absent
subsumed.evidence: native-job-secrets.test.mjs:304-308 supplies case changes, trailing whitespace, nested arrays and objects pretending to be native-secrets capability entries. subsumed.unit: tests/token-last-used.test.mjs::a refused command still counts as a use of a valid token; its rolled-back writes do not take the stamp along

subsumed.unit: tests/ui-billing.test.mjs::a developer never sees Settings, Billing even where billing is on

subsumed.evidence: ui-contrast.test.mjs:67-70 evaluates NON_TEXT pairs, including borders, focus rings and chart marks, against 3:1 in both themes. TEXT at 63-66 has a different pair matrix and a 4.5:1 threshold; several non-text pairs are absent from it.

subsumed.unit: tests/ui-features.test.mjs::console copy never names a feature switch by its registry key
subsumed.evidence: ui-features.test.mjs:192-208 scans user-facing console copy for internal FEATURE_KEYS, with syntax exclusions. Pricing and import-shadowing scans do not inspect that rule. A feature identifier leaking into prose can pass both listed subsumers.

subsumed.evidence: ui-import-shadowing.test.mjs:26-44 collects local variable/destructuring declarations that reuse imported names. The pricing and feature-copy tests inspect unrelated prose/content constraints. The shared found=[] assertion loses the declaration-analysis semantics.

subsumed.unit: tests/ui-quality.test.mjs::web performance: the browser copy of the report model is the server module, byte for byte
subsumed.evidence: ui-quality.test.mjs:251-257 compares public/generated/web-report.mjs with src/lib/web-report.mjs and checks its generated header. browser.test.mjs:54-113 checks separate docker/web-quality copies and toolchain pins. A stale browser copy can coexist with correct Docker copies even though the normalized copy/source assertions match.

subsumed.unit: tests/ui-route-audit.test.mjs::route audit: every context item and main menu item opens a routed page; markers left from the split are reported
subsumed.evidence: ui-route-audit.test.mjs:145-184 enumerates every context/menu item, resolves its destination and records stale todo/next/anchor/redirect markers and wrong active items. The alternatives check rendered links, accessibility, redirect behavior or route declarations. They do not enumerate the same navigation configuration or provide these strict-mode diagnostics.

subsumed.unit: tests/ui-route-audit.test.mjs::route audit: every in-app link on every page (owner, seeded data) opens a routed page
subsumed.evidence: ui-route-audit.test.mjs:334-356 crawls seeded rendered pages and resolves their actual links, including content-generated links outside the menus. The other audits inspect menu definitions, route metadata, redirects or accessibility. All call report(fail), but only this one constructs failures from those rendered links; it also reports unseeded coverage.

subsumed.unit: tests/ui-route-audit.test.mjs::route audit: every page has one h1, labelled landmarks, one current context item, named controls and labelled fields
subsumed.evidence: ui-route-audit.test.mjs:363-378 inspects a11yProblems for each rendered page, with explicit exemptions for h1 and current-item rules. Link resolution and route/menu metadata cannot catch unnamed controls, unlabelled fields or malformed landmarks. Matching report() assertions conceal the different violation lists.

subsumed.unit: tests/ui-route-audit.test.mjs::route audit: every redirect lands on a routed page, keeps the other query parameters and never loops; old links land on their new routes
subsumed.evidence: ui-route-audit.test.mjs:209-273 probes guarded routes across owner/viewer/operator, billing and desktop contexts, preserves keep/query values, detects loops and checks OLD_LINKS land on their intended routes. Other audits do not run this principal/query matrix or verify preservation and legacy destinations. Strict diagnostics are also useful beyond assert calls.

subsumed.unit: tests/ui-route-audit.test.mjs::route audit: every route declares a valid context, or is a record, a global page, a redirect or an area without a context
subsumed.evidence: ui-route-audit.test.mjs:92-143 validates declared context IDs, sections, record parameters and missing contexts, including catch-all redirect requirements and the NO_CONTEXT exceptions. A page can remain reachable and accessible while its route metadata violates these rules, so the four report(fail) subsumers do not replace it.

subsumed.unit: tests/ui-tabs.test.mjs::tabs: a hidden tab cannot be opened by value
subsumed.evidence: ui-tabs.test.mjs:149-153 marks findings hidden, assigns that value and requires overview to stay visible. Its subsumers select visible tabs or check initial setup. They do not test refusing programmatic activation of a hidden tab.

subsumed.unit: tests/ui-tabs.test.mjs::tabs: on arrival exactly one panel is open, the first tab
subsumed.evidence: ui-tabs.test.mjs:92-96 mounts with tabs assigned before connectedCallback. The subsumer at 103-109 explicitly assigns them after connection. These exercise different lifecycle orderings; a regression in initial connection with preexisting tabs can leave late assignment working.

subsumed.unit: tests/ui-volt-evals.test.mjs::Lists: an empty state never repeats the header primary as a second lime button
subsumed.evidence: ui-volt-evals.test.mjs:139-150 opens five empty evaluation list routes and requires exactly one primary action on each. The subsumers cover a not-found page, a populated pipeline audit and Get started. The same selector/count on those pages does not protect evaluation empty-state actions.

subsumed.unit: tests/ui-workspace-dense.test.mjs::workspace pages have no context sidebar and no section picker (NAVIGATION.md)
subsumed.evidence: ui-workspace-dense.test.mjs:173-185 checks six workspace pages, including overview, projects, speed, Get started and guides, have neither context sidebar nor section picker. ui-contexts.test.mjs:168-210 checks that absence only on /failures while exercising rail transitions. It does not cover the other five route configurations.

subsumed.unit: tests/web-report-platform.test.mjs::revoking a link stops the public page immediately, and so does turning the switch off
subsumed.evidence: web-report-platform.test.mjs:437-449 checks a working link, force-off refusal, restoration after re-enable, then explicit share revocation causing 404. The subsumer at 450-461 checks switch refusal and view accounting but never revokes the share. Losing immediate revocation would pass it.

subsumed.unit: tests/workflow-optimizer-api.test.mjs::daily limits: per project and per workspace
subsumed.evidence: workflow-optimizer-api.test.mjs:231-238 seeds five recent optimization records and requires 429 OPTIMIZER_RATE_LIMITED with no GitHub writes. The subsumer instead requires REPOSITORY_FORK or GITHUB_WORKFLOWS_PERMISSION on different fixtures. Their rejection predicates are distinct despite the [Function] fingerprint. The title overstates coverage: this body does not separately exhaust the workspace-wide limit.

A connected but inert menu is a real interaction gap.

Internal-link interception, modifier exclusions and hash scrolling are not established by the route tests.

A successful edit can leave stale quota/audit views undetected.

They check paths/links, but those can come from ustar prefixes or GNU long names while incidental PAX metadata is ignored. There is no format-controlled oracle for this parser's override behavior, especially traversal/link overrides; the Python untar tests exercise a different implementation.

This oracle does not verify retained safe context, the REDACTED marker or length bounds; those remain gaps, but the survivor alone does not mean redaction safety has no check.

Fresh inventory rebuilding can yield the same snapshot. This reuse gap is real, while the reported whole-function mutation boundary/name should be corrected before interpreting it as a function-level result.

Those tests assert updated limits only after independently clearing the caches, bypassing the behavior forgetPlans must supply to normal requests. Test a warmed cache followed by mutation and immediate read without reset.

pseudo.name: runCost
pseudo.evidence: services/shadow.mjs:42-57 reads usage_resources for this tenant/run, prices each row, sums/rounds cost and returns null for absent data or errors. shadow.test.mjs:184-228 calls observeShadow but checks publication suppression, pairing, disagreement and duration, not observation cost; pure verdict fixtures inject costUsd directly. Neither verifies this SQL scope/pricing/sum or null behavior. Domain container-cost runCost tests exercise another function.

pseudo.name: nextOutbox
pseudo.evidence: sql-store.mjs:570-572 finds the earliest future next_at for a particular outbox kind, excluding due items, to avoid redundant warm/predict scheduling. drop-in-warm.test.mjs:189-229 checks runners and nextAt, and drop-in-predict.test.mjs checks signal/runner idempotency, not the number/timing of future dropin-warm outbox entries. Returning nothing can enqueue redundant future ticks while those behaviors pass. A fixture with due/future entries and multiple kinds is needed to check the actual minimum and scheduling deduplication.
